sloka: पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुग्रीवः सहजाम्बवान् ।अदूरान्मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहुबलानुगः ।। ६.४१.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: paścimena tu rāmasya sugrīvaḥ sahajāmbavān ।adūrānmadhyame gulme tasthau bahubalānugaḥ ।। 6.41.43 ।।।।

translations.english: By the command of Rama, Vibheeshana accompanied by Lakshmana posted crores and crores of Vanaras there.
